subject: Rename redis_init_script file and its content (#357)
reason: The change only renames utils/redis_init_script(.tpl) to valkey_init_script(.tpl) and updates variable names and user-facing strings inside those shell scripts and utils/install_server.sh. These are installation/init-script helpers, not part of valkey-server, the tools, or any runtime behaviour: no command, reply, replication, persistence or config path is affected, so no fuzzer scenario can reach it and none is needed.
